name: agent-visual
description: Draws each mermaid block of a reply in place as Unicode box art colored by the theme, shows a line that is only a local image as the picture, and gives the model the drawing rules in rules.md. The same core as the pi extension in pi/.

edgeColor.title: Edge color
edgeColor.description: Theme color for diagram lines and arrows: teal (planMode, closest to pi), gray (inactive), blue (suggestion), orange (claude).

experimentalTypes.title: Experimental diagram types
experimentalTypes.description: Also draw the less common types (journey, quadrant, xychart, C4, architecture, kanban, zenuml, venn, wardley, railroad and more) instead of showing their framed source.

cellSize.title: Terminal cell size
cellSize.description: A terminal cell's size in screen pixels, as WxH (e.g. 14x28), so a picture shows at its own size: one picture pixel on one screen pixel. auto: 14x28 on macOS (Ghostty on a Retina screen at its default font), 8x16 elsewhere.
